sources: Sources: Al Jazeera, CNN, The Wall Street Journal, Kyiv Independent, NHK World, The National, Dawn, Associated Press — 20 Nov 2026. Figures as reported on the day; casualty counts may be revised.

stories.headline: ICJ Rules Myanmar Committed Genocide
stories.summary: The International Court of Justice ruled 9-6 on 19 November that Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya.

stories.headline: Trilateral Peace Declaration Signed in Shenzhen
stories.summary: Trump, Xi and Putin signed four points on UN reform, energy, the ICC and nuclear risk.

stories.headline: Russia Launches Massive Strike on Ukraine
stories.summary: Over 400 drones and 111 missiles killed at least eight people and damaged three Kyiv bridges.

stories.headline: Anthropic Debuts on Nasdaq
stories.summary: Shares closed at $97.17, up 17% from IPO price, while the Nasdaq fell about 2%.

stories.headline: Houthi Missile Strikes Riyadh Tower
stories.summary: A missile shattered windows on floors 7-8 of Riyadh's tallest tower with no injuries reported.

stories.headline: NATO Jets Scramble After Poland Strike
stories.summary: Two Kh-101 missiles and one jet-powered drone fell in Poland; no one was injured.
